differences.what: A module, exam_heent_eyes, that the General note type includes: its section Eyes shows only while HEENT (exam.systems is heent) is picked in the exam picker, and offers one-tap Normal. HEENT is four modules, one for each sub-exam (eyes, ears, nose, mouth and throat), each with its own Normal.
differences.why: PRD main 414; forms 6.3; focused-exam inventory default 10, 11

differences.what: The guidance line is not typed: it is why HEENT is four sections.

Pupils is choose-many. PERRL is the normal option and clears the others. PERRLA, the same normal pupils with accommodation, clears the others too, so neither is held beside an abnormal pupil; Normal fills PERRL. Other asks for a short text.

If unequal: the two sizes are one number with sides, Pupil size, in mm from 1 to 9 with one decimal (so a half millimetre can be typed: the format has no step), and the reaction is asked for each pupil, Pupil reaction, choose-one with sides. Both show only while Unequal pupils is picked. The bullets Right pupil and Left pupil are the two sides, not options.
Extraocular movements is choose-many. Intact is the normal option and clears the others.
Conjunctiva is choose-many. Normal is the normal option and clears the others.
Sclera is choose-one. Anicteric is the normal option.
Visual symptoms is choose-many. Vision normal is the normal option and clears the others.
Other is a text box, Other eye findings, for what has no side (conjunctiva, sclera and eye movements have none). Normal leaves it empty.
